structured_output.what_is_happening: GO/LESGO is a 46-minute-old PumpSwap pool. It was created directly on the AMM 4 seconds after the mint (migrated_unix=0, not on the curve). The token has a very popular name: the packet lists 10 other "LESGO/GO" tokens. One is at $8.8M mcap with $4.3M liquidity and one at $5.2M is still trading. Several ~$1.4M-mcap clones show liquidity about equal to mcap, and a few ~$1.5M clones sit at around $560 of liquidity, which looks like they were already drained. This pair has done $1.27M volume on about $56k of liquidity (22.7x turnover in an hour) and is up about 350%. The trade flow is badly lopsided: 2,057 unique buyers against only 53 unique sellers, with 1,400 sells. The "rest" of holders own 1.4% of supply. The creator has closed out, the LP is 0% locked/burned, and RugCheck flags "Large Amount of LP Unlocked" and "Low amount of LP Providers".

narrative.description: LESGO appears to be a real trending ticker elsewhere, given the $5-9M same-name tokens and the lesgodotfun handle. This contract is one of many clones riding that name, not the source of the story.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely name confusion plus bot-made activity: many small buyer wallets and a few repeat sellers. Any real spread belongs to the canonical LESGO, not to this clone.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name/ticker. The GeckoTerminal twitter handle 'lesgodotfun' has probably been copied from the original project, and there is no website, no DexScreener profile and no links.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name GO/LESGO tokens: DKGi… ($8.8M mcap, $4.3M liq, created about 6.75h earlier), D1YZ… ($5.2M, active volume, about 21h old, likely the canonical one) and many ~$1.4M clones with liquidity equal to mcap or already drained.

authenticity.evidence: 2,057 unique buyers against 53 unique sellers, with holders beyond the top 40 owning 1.4% of supply. That fits a dust-wallet bot spraying buys to inflate holder counts while a few wallets sell repeatedly. It sits alongside a serial clone pattern on the same name, a single-provider unlocked LP, the creator having closed out, and 22x hourly turnover on a thin pool.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN shows no bundlers, snipers or fresh wallets and a 0 bot rate. Some real buyers confused about the ticker could be taking part.

structural_risks: LP 0% locked/burned, with a single or few LP providers who can pull at any time
Several same-name clones already drained to about $560 liquidity, a repeat rug template
Creator closed out; the pool was made directly on PumpSwap with no curve
Volume is about 22x liquidity, with buyers concentrated in dust wallets
Price already fell back about 19% from its high; m30 was -12%

structured_output.counterargument: If LESGO is a hot ticker, confused buyers could keep pouring in. From about $56k, a doubling to about $110k only needs modest real inflow, and sister clones reportedly reached ~$1.4M displayed mcap. GMGN finds no snipers, bundlers or insiders, and the top holders are spread out at 1.6-4.5% each.
unknowns: Who holds the LP tokens and when they plan to pull
Whether the ~$1.4M-mcap clones ever had real trading or just showed fake-looking liquidity equal to mcap
Which LESGO is canonical and how much real attention it has
Whether the 2,057 buyers are real people

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a clone of a trending ticker with an unlocked single-provider LP and bot-shaped flow (thousands of dust buyers, 53 sellers). Several siblings have already been drained. The most likely outcome is an LP pull within hours, not a 2x from entry.
